authorisation.scope: Start a new stage-one training run; do not start shaping.

research_role.question: Can the unchanged default Ant-v5/PPO reference configuration produce minimally competent locomotion in fresh uninterrupted training runs?
research_role.purpose: Resolve whether the failed two-seed V4 reference gate is consistent with continuation discontinuity or small-sample variation, or instead indicates persistent baseline-configuration weakness.
research_role.evaluation_episode_role: nested repeated observation of a fixed trained policy; not an independent training replicate

intended_behaviour.task: Sustained and effective net forward locomotion over a maximum 1,000-step episode while satisfying the finite-state and torso-height health rule.
intended_behaviour.health_scope: Gymnasium Ant-v5 finite-state and torso-height rule only; not comprehensive robot health or physical safety.

reference_competence_gate.role: Predeclared operational interpretability screen; not a literature-derived success threshold or physical-safety claim.

per_policy.joint_rule: Both thresholds must be satisfied by the same independently trained policy.

configuration_level.interpretation: Descriptive prospective decision rule, not a null-hypothesis significance test.

analysis_rules.episode_aggregation: Aggregate the 20 evaluation episodes within each trained policy before applying the policy gate.
analysis_rules.checkpoint_dependence: Checkpoints are repeated measurements of one evolving policy and are descriptive only.
analysis_rules.negative_result_rule: Retain and report every seed. Do not replace a failed policy or alter thresholds after inspection.
analysis_rules.decision_if_supported: Proceed to a separate held-out stage-one protocol freeze; do not automatically start candidate or shaping training.
analysis_rules.decision_if_inconclusive_or_failed: Freeze a separate reference-configuration pilot before changing normalisation, architecture or optimisation settings.

stopping_and_failure_rules.planned_stop: After all five independently trained reference policies have been evaluated at the 1M primary endpoint.
stopping_and_failure_rules.partial_task_rule: Preserve any partial policy directory for audit and require manual adjudication before a rerun.
stopping_and_failure_rules.non_finite_rule: Retain the affected policy and logs, record the failure, and do not substitute a new seed.
stopping_and_failure_rules.system_stop: Stop only for non-finite training failure, unrecoverable I/O error, insufficient storage, or explicit user interruption.

claim_boundary: This reference-only development diagnostic can resolve baseline competence under the unchanged tested configuration. It cannot establish reward misspecification, reward hacking, an optimal coefficient, PPO generality or real-robot safety.
